utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Kira, have you heard about the repair drive happening this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? Are you sure that's a thing? Who's organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh yeah, it's real! The community center's putting it on. They're fixing up donated electronics and stuff.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Noah, have you heard about the repair drive happening next weekend?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think I saw a flyer... or was that last month?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. I'm planning to bring my old blender.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got the parts for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Parts? Oh, I haven't heard anything about that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Check with the HOA office. They were supposed to order them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, the repair drive? I didn't know it was happening. When is it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's this Saturday from 10 to 4 at the community center. We're collecting tools and spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might have some old tools I could bring. Do you need all sorts, or just specific things?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Jules, are you free next Tuesday to help with the repair drive pickup?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think I'm free on Tuesday. What time and where should I meet you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, let's meet at the school parking lot at 10 AM. I'll have the list of items ready.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good morning, Oren. What's the schedule for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I... uh, I think it's at 10? Or was it 11? Sorry, I can never remember these things.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's check the community board; I need a solid time to plan my day.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia! I'm rallying folks for the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday. Can I count you in?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I'd love to help, but I'm a bit worried about how we'll manage the tools and materials. Do we have a plan for that?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely! I've already talked to a few folks who are lending their tools, and we're making a list. Don't worry, we'll have everything organized!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there's a repair drive happening? What's that about?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, yes! It's a community event where we fix up donated items and give them to families in need. We're meeting Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds wonderful! Do you need any volunteers or donations?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mara, could you tell me more about the repair drive and what we need to do?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure! We're collecting broken household items to fix them together this Saturday at the community center. Just bring anything small you'd like repaired.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara! When exactly on Saturday, and should we bring any tools or just the items?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hey Dane, thanks for organizing this repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem, happy to help out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I've been meaning to ask, could you spare some time for my fence? It's been broken for a while.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mina, I heard about the repair drive—I've got a whole shed full of tools if anyone needs to borrow something.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good to know. Do you have a list of what you're offering, or should I just stop by and take a look?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Feel free to stop by anytime this weekend; I'll be out in the shed organizing everything.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: A repair drive? Where is that happening?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I think it's at the community center? Or maybe the park? I just heard about it in passing.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Let me check the community center schedule; I think they have something posted online.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Need any tools for the repair drive? I've got a full set in the garage.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's kind of you. I might need a wrench or two later.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, just let me know what size you need and I'll bring 'em over.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Do we have enough supplies for the repair drive? I hope we aren't short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure we have everything we need? I don't want to start and run out halfway.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Let's double-check the inventory list together to make sure we've got enough for the whole job.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, how's the planning for the repair drive going? I heard we might need some extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It's coming along! We've got a good list of tasks, but extra hands would definitely help. Are you free on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, I should be free! What time should I come by, and is there anything specific you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Dane, what do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Cleo, just got here—what's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I'm checking the inventory now. Do you have a list of materials we're short on?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Faye, have you heard about the repair drive happening this Saturday? I heard they're fixing up bikes and small appliances.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that sounds great! But I've got to check if it conflicts with any school activities first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It's from 10 to 2 at the community center, so hopefully it works out!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, is the repair drive still on for this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it's still on for Saturday morning at 10! We'll be meeting in the community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, I'll be there. Do I need to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Leo, what's this about a repair drive? Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, my truck broke down. Could use a jump start if you've got cables.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I've got cables in my trunk. Let's get that truck going.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive sounds great! I can help spread the word around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's so kind of you! I've heard it's a great way to get things fixed around here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I'll start telling everyone at the next block party! Should I print flyers too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Eli, are you here about the repair drive? What's the location this time?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: The community center on Oak Street, same as last time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Ah, the Oak Street community center. I'll make a note of that. What time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you tell me more about what needs repairing or what the drive involves?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We're fixing up the community center and the old playground equipment. Could use some tools and hands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Oren, any word on the repair drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I'm sorry, I completely forgot to check on that. Let me see if I can remember where I put the tools...

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You forgot? It's been a few days, we really need to get that done.
